data.body: Held-out TDD contract card. ADR 0100 sections 3 through 5 require fixed-width committed help bytes, pre-operation serving, and handler-owned nested help. Preconditions were confirmed. Twenty-one visible intercept routes lack artifacts, identity child parsers reject `--help`, and runtime nested ownership omits five parser-backed families. The production paths are the public generator entry point, in-process CLI dispatch, and CLI subprocesses. Exact postconditions are committed-byte equality, zero operation-path calls, zero repository state, successful child usage, cross-width equality, and preserved trusted-env usage lines. Focused RED produced six visible failures and eight held-out failures for those reasons. The existing `config validate --help` child-parser contract passed as the control. The held-out source is outside the worktree at `/Users/joeoakhart/f12-heldout-oracle/oracle.py`.
